source.title: TBH: Task Bar Hero Steam Market commodity items
source.attribution: Data from Steam Bulk Sell (https://steambulksell.com/data/), licensed CC BY 4.0.

limitations: This catalog includes only Steam commodity items that can be used by Steam Multisell.
It does not include every non-commodity Steam Market listing, so it is not a complete AppID 3678970 market dictionary.
It contains exact Steam market_hash_name values, display names, icon URLs and listing URLs, but no Chinese translations or TBH ItemKey.

translationJoin.method: exact marketHashName equality against the generated game pack
